Bringing the Power of Law to All

We are the country’s leading nonprofit access to justice innovator with a 25-year history of impact.

Donate
Learn More

9 out of 10 low-income Americans don’t have access to adequate legal assistance.

Each year, millions of Americans face loss and adversity in critical areas of their lives because the legal help they need is unavailable or unaffordable.

Embracing community-based partnerships, collaborative design, and technology to scale access to justice

We work alongside legal aid providers, courts, and community organizations to develop digital tools that empower people, expand access to legal help, and build a future where the law belongs to everyone.

LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR APPROACH TO SCALING  JUSTICE

Our digital tools and partnerships enable people to understand their rights, access justice, and live more secure lives.

Our national impact

For over 25 years, we've connected millions to essential legal help, supported those who deliver it, and pioneered sustainable innovations that transform access to justice in America.

Learn more About How We Help
Lawhelpny
LawHelpNY empowers more than 500,000 New Yorkers each year with free legal information and support to protect their safety, family, home, or livelihood.
Lawhelp Network
Our LawHelp network spans 15 states, helping nearly 25,000 people a day understand their rights, make informed decisions, and connect to help in their local community.
Citizenshipworks
Citizenshipworks makes applying for citizenship safer, simpler, and more affordable, supporting more than 60,000 people in the naturalization process.
LawHelp interactive
LawHelp Interactive helps over a million people each year complete vital court forms for free, leveling the playing field for people without lawyers.
Justicialab
Justicia Lab has developed more than a dozen immigrant justice legal tools, helping more than 500,000 people find critical immigration information and relief.

March 16, 2026 — NEW YORK, NY — Pro Bono Net, the nation’s leading nonprofit access to justice technology innovator, today announced it is rebranding as Scale Justice, marking a new chapter in the organization’s 25-plus-year commitment to making legal help more equitable and attainable for millions...Continue Reading
